description: This PHP class 'JsonSerializerDocumentifier' creates a human-friendly document representation of a SugarBean object using BeanJsonSerializer, for use in search indexing within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: JsonSerializerDocumentifier
classes.description: A class that converts SugarBean objects into a human-readable document format for search purposes, using BeanJsonSerializer.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the serializer instance using BeanJsonSerializer::make().

methods.name: documentify
methods.description: Converts a SugarBean object into an array, applies fixes for phone and email fields, removes the 'id' field, and returns the resulting array.
